decisions.rationale: Names a single defined condition, hereditary deficiency of complement component C5, with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease. The full phrase is kept rather than a substring, as in the C7 deficiency example.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span); Examples 6

decisions.rationale: The disease term C5-deficient is used adjectivally to modify the noun phrase human serum, so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: Repeats the title's hereditary C5 deficiency as a specific disease mention in the abstract. Duplicate mentions are annotated separately.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: C5-deficient modifies the noun serum (C5-deficient human serum), so it is used as a Modifier rather than a standalone disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: Abbreviation C5D is a short form of C5-deficient used as a modifier of human serum; the short form is annotated as its own mention with modifier role.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers); What to Annotate 6 (synonymous mentions)

decisions.rationale: C5D modifies the noun homozygotes (C5D homozygotes), describing a disease-defined patient group, so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: Systemic lupus erythematosus is a named, specific disease of the proband, so it is a Specific Disease.
Escherichia coli is named only as the source of endotoxin used to induce chemotaxis. The organism is not the disease being discussed, so it is not annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 1 (organism names not annotated unless the disease they cause is discussed)

decisions.rationale: C5 deficiency refers to the specific heterozygous condition in family members, a defined disease state, so it is a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 6 (C7 deficiency)

decisions.rationale: C5D modifies the noun serum (C5D serum), so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: Saccharomyces cerevisiae is an organism used as an opsonization target in the assay. No disease caused by it is discussed, so it is not annotated.
Candida albicans is an organism used as an opsonization target in the assay. No disease it causes is discussed, so it is not annotated.
C5D modifies the noun serum (C5D serum was capable of promoting phagocytosis), so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: Staphylococcus aureus is an organism used as a phagocytosis and killing target. No disease it causes is discussed, so it is not annotated.
Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria is a named, specific disease of the patient whose erythrocytes were lysed, so it is a Specific Disease.
Salmonella typhi is an organism used as a bactericidal test target. No disease it causes is discussed, so it is not annotated.
S . typhi is an abbreviated organism name used as a lysis target. No disease it causes is discussed, so it is not annotated.
